set.body: Scope: PRD Phases 6-7. Attach response sources to acquisition context through checked alignment, lower existing dataset selections only into the decoded response domain, assemble the explicit runtime, and prove the same representation semantics through Zarr as well as memory and LNA. Close only when segmentation and existing queries remain compatible, geometry and timing mismatches fail explicitly, provenance and receipts reach results, browser and JVM plans agree, and locality claims match observed reads.
set.title: EPIC RRA-C: dataset attachment, runtime composition, and Zarr proof
